description: Public Arachne nonlinear-width marker forwarding and analytic taper contracts.

mutants.test_filter: Arachne factory wrappers preserve nonlinear width thresholds
mutants.description: Dropping the parent marker at the factory outermost cap must fail the public marker-presence assertion, including both the plain and nonzero-outer-offset strategies.

mutants.test_filter: Arachne taper preserves the output-width floor at its analytic thickness
mutants.description: Skipping the public pipeline consumer of nonlinear width markers must fail the independently derived piecewise-linear width floor at the analytic local thickness.
